caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top and a box-like apron beneath. The wood is a medium brown color, showing visible grain and shading to suggest depth and natural texture. The table is supported by four turned legs, each featuring a series of rounded bulges and segments. The legs are connected near the base by stretchers, which are also turned and match the detail of the legs, forming a rectangular support frame close to the floor. There is a single horizontal handle on the front side of the apron, indicating the presence of a drawer. The background is plain and beige, emphasizing the table as the central and only object in the composition. The artist’s signature, "Harry Eisman," appears in small letters at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Tavern Table
